candidates.claim: sw-ot-01 defines a read-write SNMP community with no ACL (acl null), which violates the policy that SNMP communities must be read-only and restricted by an ACL permitting only MGMT hosts.
candidates.remediation: Remove the read-write SNMP community on sw-ot-01, or make it read-only and restrict it with an ACL that permits only MGMT hosts.

candidates.claim: The current snapshot of sw-ot-01 adds an snmp-server community line that is absent from the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added SNMP community with the approved baseline: remove it or record an approved change.
